dishes.name: Râpée stéphanoise
dishes.desc: Crisp pan-fried galette of grated potato, egg and garlic, originally from Saint-Étienne. Often eaten with sarasson or a salad.

dishes.name: Sarasson
dishes.desc: Fresh curd cheese of the Forez mixed with cream, garlic and herbs, spread on country bread or eaten with potatoes.

dishes.name: Barboton
dishes.desc: Lamb stew simmered for hours with potatoes and carrots in a cast-iron pot so the vegetables absorb the meat juices. A Stéphanois home dish.

dishes.name: Bugnes stéphanoises
dishes.desc: Fried yeast dough, softer and thicker than the crisp Lyon bugne. A carnival sweet of Saint-Étienne.

dishes.name: Fourme de Montbrison
dishes.desc: Mild blue cow's milk cheese with an orange rind, protected by AOP since 2002. Made in the Forez mountains and the emblematic cheese of the Loire.
